hypothesis: A continuous clockwise cross-seal draw can make SVG winding behave as material memory: a real aperture becomes mass because contour orientation changes how the compound path is produced.
changedRule: A valid gate-to-gate crossing flips the next aperture's winding and creases the enclosing contour; short, same-gate, and counter-clockwise gestures are refused.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one dark angular compound seal with three apertures. Accepted crossings change the actual hole/mass topology and outer silhouette.
falsifier: Any cosmetic-only response, invalid gesture commit, unchanged compound path, reset of earlier inversions, or generic blind reading falsifies the direction.
deletionCondition: Delete if the caption-free object reads as a logo, pressure diagram, or route map rather than a changed topology, or if exact lifting fails.

critiques.argument: The silhouette and three apertures must carry the work before the viewer reads controls.
Only a real cross-seal clockwise draw may change path data; invalid paths must remain geometry-neutral.
Winding must produce mass/absence, not a colour-coded state.
The blind seal still needs independent caption-free review against v045-v047.
Delete if the object is a generic mark or the gesture is a button in disguise.
